name: org.glassfish.grizzly:grizzly-http
reason: Grizzly 5.0.3 contains HttpCodecFilter and HTTP packet types. The inspected filter requires a FilterChainContext; a standalone local-buffer control adapter is still unverified.

name: io.snice.codecs:codec-http
reason: Maven codec search lead; parsing API and local control result have not been established.

name: org.webpieces:http-parser1_1
reason: Historical WebPieces artifact may be a prior distribution of the included parser; package identity and a separate pinned control remain unchecked.

name: io.undertow:undertow-core
reason: The pinned 2.4.4.Final JAR contains native HTTP/1.1 RequestParser and ResponseParser classes, but both are package-private with package-private handle methods. No documented public local message parsing API was established for this release.

name: com.authlete.http:http-field-parser
reason: Parses selected HTTP header fields rather than a complete HTTP/1.1 request or response message; a registry search hit does not establish the required format scope.

name: org.eclipse.jetty.http2:jetty-http2
reason: HTTP/2 module, not the HTTP/1.1 message parser tested in jetty-http.

name: org.eclipse.jetty.http3:jetty-http3
reason: HTTP/3 module, not an HTTP/1.1 message parser.
